attBesluta.text: The tools are very useful, reasonably priced, excellent quality, and delivered very quickly. I'm very satisfied with my purchase!
The Socket set is of good quality and the price is amazing. Very satiated with the purchase.
This is a good set and well priced. It was exactly what I expected when I received it.

if you are looking for a nice 3/8 drive and 1/4 drive socket set both in deep well and standard for a good price this is the one to get only problem was in 1/4 drive there is no 14mm or 9/16 socket in both deep and standard so you have to add those in other wise a nice set
Not the best quality but for the price it's not bad..will get you off the side of the road in a pinch.
I needed a 1/2 inch set for work and found this one. tI works great and has all the pieces I needed. Fantastic price! I love the Vevor site they have great stuff!
Outstanding…my third Vevor tool kit and very impressive quality…highly recommended 👍

The tools themselves are solid, especially for the price. The ratchets feel good in the hand and everything seems well made. For a budget socket set, it’s a great value. The case, however, is pretty terrible. Most cases like this aren’t great, but this one is worse than most. Sockets don’t stay put very well and it just feels flimsy. That said, if you care more about the tools than the case, it’s still a solid buy.
Nice set both standard and metric all one set
Dovevo togliere una puleggia da una pompa. Ho ordinato il set di estrattori e in un attimo ho fatto il lavoro. Grazie
Zeer goed gemaakt trekkers, leuk die verschillende afmetingen en zowel als binnen en buitentrekker te gebruiken

This set is very good value for occasional use. The casting is solid and will work fine. The jaws are alittle course and in some applications may require some grinding. I expect as an old retired millwright they will meet my needs fine after I got rid of my good sets thinking I was done
